heading: Calibration, repairs and sales services
metaDescription: Calibration, on-site calibration, repairs and tool-error adjustment, and spare parts and instruments from JIE in Belgaum and Hubli.
intro: JIE provides calibration, on-site calibration, repairs and tool-error adjustment, and the supply of spare parts and instruments for industrial measuring instruments, gauges and test equipment.

Services cover mechanical measuring instruments, pressure gauges, electro-technical instruments, thermal instruments, flow instruments, bio-medical equipment and civil testing equipment. Calibration is traceable to National / International Standards.

faq.question: Which services does JIE provide?
faq.answer: Calibration, on-site calibration, repairs and tool-error adjustment, and the supply of spare parts and instruments.

faq.question: Where are the calibration lab and branch office?
faq.answer: The calibration lab is at Shree Complex, Block No. 7, 1st Floor, Plot No. 182/A/186, Udyambag, Belgaum - 590 008. The branch office is at H.No. 28, Hemareddi Mallamma Colony, R.N. Shetty Road, Hubli - 580 024.

faq.question: How do I request calibration or a repair?
faq.answer: Contact JIE on WhatsApp or by phone. Repair and calibration work starts with receiving and inspecting the instrument, followed by calibration, documentation and return.

faq.question: Do you serve industries, institutes and hospitals?
faq.answer: Yes. JIE serves industries, technical institutes, medical institutes, hospitals, government projects, and regulatory and audit requirements.

faq.question: Is on-site calibration available?
faq.answer: Yes, for selected instruments and equipment, including surface plates, Trimos, bench centers, CMMs, hardness testers, UTM, FTM, CTM and pressure gauges.
